claims.sourceText: Memorandum for Assistant Chief of Staff for Intelligence, 'INSCOM CENTER LANE Project (U)', 17 July 1984, CIA-RDP96-00788R001500100011-4, https://archive.org/download/cia-readingroom-document-cia-rdp96-00788r001500100011-4/cia-rdp96-00788r001500100011-4_djvu.txt ; disposition form IAFM-OPS-HUP, 'Reorganization of HQ INSCOM and CONUS Elements', 16 Nov 79, CIA-RDP96-00788R002000190002-9, https://archive.org/download/cia-readingroom-document-cia-rdp96-00788r002000190002-9/cia-rdp96-00788r002000190002-9_djvu.txt
claims.text: INSCOM's own letterhead in this period reads 'DEPARTMENT OF THE ARMY / UNITED STATES ARMY INTELLIGENCE AND SECURITY COMMAND / ARLINGTON HALL STATION / ARLINGTON, VIRGINIA 22212', and a 1979 headquarters disposition form records that 'HQ INSCOM will be consolidated at AHS, VA' alongside the creation of a brigade at Fort George G. Meade.
